title: The winning play that lost the spread
summary: T.J. Hockenson stopped short of the end zone so Minnesota could finish in victory formation. The Vikings won 15–10, leaving a documented -10.5 spread uncovered.

timeline.label: Final drive
timeline.text: Hockenson caught a pass and went down near the goal line.

timeline.label: Finish
timeline.text: Minnesota used kneel-downs to end the game.

unusual: The football objective was securing the win. That objective diverged from what favorite spread bettors needed.
explanations: Avoiding another Miami possession explains the slide. The team report spots it at the 2; betting accounts commonly describe the 1.
questions: No individual ticket or universal closing line is asserted.

sources.label: Vikings: clock, timeout and reception context

statistics.label: Receiving
statistics.method: Vikings team report; no derived rate.

betting.provenance: Reported game line in Yahoo Sports’ Week 4 betting recap; book and exact capture time not specified.
betting.outcome: Final margin: 15 − 10 = 5. Minnesota -10.5 loses; Miami +10.5 wins.
betting.caution: This describes that documented line only, not every available price.

potential_bets.impact: Choosing to slide rather than score could affect an anytime-touchdown wager if he did not score elsewhere; no actual ticket is verified.
The documented -10.5 line lost by 5.5 points. One touchdown alone would not necessarily have made this spread cover.
